snippet.title: Coal Duty -  Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Coal Duty is a first-person action-adventure game where you descend into dangerous mines to collect coal and valuable resources.
Complete assignments for an authoritarian regime, manage operations with a 4 player crew, and push deeper into procedurally generated underground zones.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4272370/Coal_Duty/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/corecrewgames/

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/4hrWcSeYqc
